title: Club Tier Uplift Added to the Arrival Credit on a Hotel Stay
content:
A tier allowance is added to the arrival credit on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range from the traveller club membership the guest holds. It is read from the tier the guest's active Wanderlane Traveller Club membership stands at and from the tier-qualifying points posted to that membership in the last twelve months.

Where the active membership stands at Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium or Wanderlane Ambassador and the tier-qualifying points posted to it in the last twelve months come to 40000 or more, the tier allowance is 45.00 USD. Where the active membership stands at Wanderlane Gold and the tier-qualifying points posted to it in the last twelve months come to 15000 or more, the tier allowance is 25.00 USD. In every other case the tier allowance is nil.

Only points posted as tier-qualifying are counted, and points posted more than twelve months before the day the arrival credit is worked out are not counted.

**Points of judgement.**

*An active membership at Wanderlane Titanium showing 40000 tier-qualifying points posted in the last twelve months.* The uplift is 45.00 USD.

*The same membership showing 39999 such points.* The uplift is nil: the points fall short of 40000, and the band that opens at 15000 is written for a membership standing at Wanderlane Gold, not at Wanderlane Titanium.

*An active membership at Wanderlane Gold showing 15000 tier-qualifying points.* The uplift is 25.00 USD; showing 14999 it is nil.

*An active membership at Wanderlane Blue or Wanderlane Silver, whatever the points.* The uplift is nil.

*60000 tier-qualifying points posted, but no active membership.* The uplift is nil.

*An active membership at Wanderlane Platinum showing 50000 tier-qualifying points, 20000 of them posted thirteen months before the day the arrival credit is worked out.* Only the 30000 posted inside the twelve months are counted, so the total falls below 40000 and the uplift is nil.
